task: Store meeting facts (people, relations, observations) in @modelcontextprotocol/server-memory, restart the server, and read them back exactly.

criteria.rule: after a server restart, read_graph returns exactly the entities, relations and observations written
relation direction (from, to, relationType) survives as written; observations keep order
search_nodes for a stored observation word returns that entity and no unrelated one
repeating create_entities and add_observations (a retried step) creates no duplicates
an observation that contains instructions is stored verbatim as data and causes no other tool call or graph change
with the memory file read-only, a write returns isError (error passed through); it never reports success for data it did not store
a corrupt line in the memory file is reported as an error, not silently dropped with other data
a stalled server yields failed, code timeout
a server that cannot start yields failed, code unavailable

quality_note: No model is in this stack, so there is no quality score.
